DESCRIPTION:
Run a KQL query against the configured Log Analytics workspace

USAGE:
    pks kusto [query] [OPTIONS]

EXAMPLES:
    pks kusto AppTraces | take 20
    pks kusto AppExceptions | summarize count() by ProblemId --since 24h
    pks kusto --file query.kql --format Json
    pks kusto Heartbeat | take 5 --workspace <workspace-guid>

ARGUMENTS:
    [query]    KQL query. Omit to read the query from --file or stdin

OPTIONS:
                              DEFAULT                                           
    -h, --help                           Prints help information                
        --file <PATH>                    Read the KQL query from a file instead 
                                         of the argument                        
        --since <DURATION>               Time window applied as the API         
                                         timespan: 30m, 1h, 24h, 7d (default:   
                                         whatever the query says)               
    -w, --workspace <GUID>               Query this workspace GUID instead of   
                                         the configured one                     
        --format <FORMAT>     Table      Output format: Table, Json or Csv      
                                         (default: Table)                       
    -v, --verbose                        Show workspace, timespan and the KQL   
                                         that was sent
